title: Ergonomic Chair Pro
description:
Overview

The Pro improves upon every detail that’s made our Ergonomic Chair the best-rated office chair on the internet. Featuring forward tilt adjustment, 5D armrests, two-way adjustable lumbar support, an optional headrest, and a wide assortment of premium materials, the Pro offers superlative support for every body at a remarkably accessible price. Learn more.

Benefits

  • 14 points of adjustment: our most configurable chair for every body
  • 5D armrests including arm width and height, as well as pad width, depth, and pivot
  • Height and depth adjustable lumbar support; completely removable
  • Seat height and depth, tilt and tilt tension, and forward seat tilt for precise alignment
  • Available in four materials: performance mesh with flocked super soft yarn, airy bouclé, scuff-resistant vegan leather, and luxurious leather
  • Optional headrest with two-axis adjustment
  • Optional extended cylinder to support taller heights
  • Meets BIFMA standard for commercial-grade use; supports 275 lbs
  • Designed by Branch in San Francisco, California

  • Not sure which chair is right for you? Compare chairs
  • Want a personalized recommendation? Take our quiz
